literal_meaning: মাঠে মৃত্যুবরণ করা (to die in the field)
figurative_meaning_bn: কোন কাজে না আসা; নষ্ট/নিস্ফল/পণ্ড হওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To be of no use; to be wasted, fruitless, or ruined
example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃষ্টিতে পূজার আনন্দ সব মাঠে মারা গেল।
এত পরিশ্রম সব মাঠে মারা গেল, কোন ফল হল না।
example_sentences_in_english: The joy of the festival was all ruined in the rain.
All that hard work went to waste; nothing came of it.
history: This idiom likely originates from agricultural contexts in Bengal, where crops dying in the fields due to floods or droughts symbolize total loss and futility.
note: Commonly used in contexts involving plans or efforts thwarted by external factors like weather.
